notes.title: MacOS Will No Longer Be Supported
notes.notes:
[b]Grid Games: Color Coded[/b] will no longer be supported for [i]MacOS[/i] due to technical issues.

Sorry for any inconvenience.

notes.title: Now Available for MacOS
notes.notes:
[b]Grid Games: Color Coded[/b] is now available for MacOS.

[b]Grid Games: Color Coded[/b] has been updated to fix some minor issues and visual layout.

The user can now interact with the [i]How To Play[/i] page.
